note: Fifty-three measured regions over twenty-eight of forty pages, resolving into 24 figure rows, 5 printed tables and 24 exclusions, with nothing unresolved and no declared gaps. Families: 13 `line` (the three rule-versus-density curves of Figures 3 to 5, the three optimal-velocity curves of Figures 6 to 8, Figure 11's three flow curves and the two comparison sets of Figures 15 to 17 and 19 to 21), 5 `table-grid`, 4 `scatter` (the four panel rows of the density visualisations), 4 `flowchart-or-schematic` (the two cell strips, the Median flowchart and the online algorithm strip) and 3 `surface-or-3D` (the continuum model's 3-D density meshes, `three_d` `surface-mesh`, two panels each). Twenty-two printed figure numbers over 24 rows, because Figures 9 and 10 are each measured as two panels. The numbering is flat with a stop throughout, all captions are in the text layer, and all twenty-nine exhibits caption below their art - tables included, against the lane's habit. Two tables break across pages and are counted once with `continued` true (Table 1 from p6 to p7, Table 5 from p8 to p9, the latter printing no Step 12); Figure 18 is one flowchart measured as seven regions, so six are `fragment-of-other`; and the appendix on p32 to p40 is twelve bands of typed C++ excluded `not-an-exhibit`. Faults worth carrying downstream: Figures 3, 4 and 5 keep a Chinese single-entry legend ('系列2') in English artwork, Figures 6 to 8 are captioned 'Optimal Maximum Velocity' while the artwork only plots phi against Vmax with no optimum marked, Figure 14's caption prints on the page after its meshes, and Table 3 carries a merged blank cell in its third column.
rules: The numbering is flat with a stop - 'Figure 1.' to 'Figure 22.' and 'Table 1.' to 'Table 5.' - so the stop forms of the enum fit every record and no exhibit is numbered without one [caption.numbering].
Every caption in this paper survives in the text layer, including the captions of the raster figures, so no caption is typed from the crop [caption.verbatim].

Every figure caption prints BELOW its artwork and every table caption below its grid as well - Tables 1 to 5 all close with their caption - against the lane's habit of captioning tables above, so the positions are recorded as printed [caption.position].

Two tables break across a page boundary and each is counted once: Table 1 begins on p6 with eleven rows and finishes on p7 with four more before its caption, and Table 5 begins on p8 with its Input row and runs through p9 to Step 18. The continuation regions are excluded `split-across-pages` and the recorded rows carry `continued` true [table.continued].

Figure 18 is one drawing whose eight label blocks were measured as seven regions: the whole flowchart is the vector region on p27 and the six small raster blocks - the start terminal, the three diamonds and the two action boxes - are excluded `fragment-of-other` rather than counted as exhibits [geometry.panel_count].

Figures 9 and 10 are each two panels rather than one plate: the low- and high-density visualisations are measured as separate left and right regions, so each gets a row per panel, the left panel carrying the caption and the citation and the right panel neither [caption.verbatim].

Figures 12, 13 and 14 are 3-D surface meshes of density over distance and time, two panels each with (a) the fast lane and (b) the slow lane, so they are recorded `surface-or-3D` with `three_d` `surface-mesh` instead of being forced into `line` [geometry.three_d].

Figures 3, 4 and 5 carry a single-entry legend left in Chinese - '系列2' - outside the frame at the right, in an otherwise English figure, and it is recorded where it is rather than translated [geometry.legend].

Figures 15 to 17 key three traffic rules across three colours inside the frame, while Figures 19 to 21 key only 'Equipped' against 'Not Equipped' in two - the same flow/safety/energy triple plotted twice, once by rule and once by optimisation [geometry.family].

Figure 11 is the only plot that writes values onto its own data - the critical points (rho_d, q_d) and (rho_u, q_u) of both lanes plus rho_c1, rho_c2, rho_c3 and rho_c arrows on the x axis - so `data_labels` is true there and false on the rest [geometry.data_labels].

The tables were numbered against the prose rather than against the layout pass: three of the five - Table 2 (the framed acceleration rule), Table 3 (the rule matrix) and Table 4 (the direction summary) - are never cited by number at all, so Table 2 carries the deictic clause that introduces it and Tables 3 and 4 the sentence on p7 about the lane-changing rule, both with an empty style list and count 0 [mention.first_page].
Figure 14 is the one exhibit whose caption and artwork part company across a page - the meshes close p21 and 'Figure 14. Normal or Higher Density' opens p22 [caption.position].

The appendix on p32 to p40 is twelve bands of typed C++ source (gen.h, SaveBMP.h, lane.h, CA.cpp and the driver), all excluded `not-an-exhibit` because none of them is captioned, numbered or drawn [caption.numbering].
